name: Notifications
author: VanillaGreen
description: The desktop notification daemon: Spotlight glass toasts on every screen, an Inbox and History panel, and Silence. Toggle the panel with the vgs.notifications:inbox shortcut or IPC.

duration.label: Toast duration
duration.description: Seconds a normal toast stays on screen; a low-urgency one stays for at most 5

customEmoji.label: Slack custom emoji
customEmoji.description: Draw each workspace's custom emoji in Slack notifications, read from Slack's own cache and, with a token that has emoji:read, from Slack's list; needs ImageMagick

slackTokens.label: Slack tokens
slackTokens.hint: One Slack app user token (xoxp-) per workspace with users:read and team:read, emoji:read optional for custom emoji. Create it at api.slack.com/apps, OAuth & Permissions, User Token Scopes.

requirements.purpose: Opens the file a notification's x-vgs-open hint names when EDITOR is unset
